title: BigQuery Vector Search — Public Pattern 5
description: Template schema for deploying a public BigQuery Vector Search analytical RAG dataset and table with an optional Cloud Run serving layer and optional GCS staging bucket.

location.description: Geographic location for BigQuery dataset (US, EU, regional).

region.description: GCP region for regional compute resources.

dataset_id.description: Unique ID for the BigQuery dataset.

table_id.description: Name of BigQuery table storing vector embeddings.

delete_contents_on_destroy.description: Whether to delete all tables when destroying dataset.

create_staging_bucket.description: Whether to create a Cloud Storage staging bucket for batch uploading documents or embeddings.

staging_bucket_name.description: Custom name for document staging bucket.

enable_cloud_run.description: Whether to deploy the optional Cloud Run FastAPI serving layer.

container_image.description: Container image URI for Cloud Run.

max_instances.description: Maximum Cloud Run instances for autoscaling.

allow_unauthenticated.description: Allow public unauthenticated access to Cloud Run endpoint.
